stage: R4 E competitive operating regions and G descriptive stability
readouts: All 16 archived widths and 6 penalties per group (96); original frozen weights, no model fitting or tuning
selection: Score all readouts on their archived disjoint 5000 validation IDs. Primary set accuracy >= .95 * group-best validation accuracy; fixed sensitivity .90 and .99. Single validation-best pair uses maximum correct count, then ascending numerical width, then ascending penalty. Evaluation truth is indexed only after these selections.
surface: Report evaluation accuracy, nearest-reference accuracy, pointwise nearest-label agreement, sharp full-width certificate coverage for (0,sigma] x [lambda,infinity), guarded finite-exclusion union using original probes in that region, strict limiting-vote prefix exclusion over original probe widths within region, their union and unresolved proportion. Region exclusion is not pointwise model disagreement.
certificate: Reconstruct unchanged training_terms/constants/query_certificate from original frozen certificate.py for each original probe width and penalty floor. Require exact equality at all 7 original endpoints x 3 original floors, zero certified sampled endpoint disagreements and empty certified/excluded intersection.
strict_witness: Normalized query scores; opposing-reference margin > 1e-10*(1+abs(competing)+abs(reference)). Lambda 0 finite witnesses require archived full numerical column rank. Strict limit witnesses use H^T Y at matching width.
scope: Validation-best choices and all retained pairs receive evaluation metrics from archived predictions once. All conditions reported including zero-coverage groups. No evaluation-based model selection.
stability: Report per-seed validation-best metrics and paired K differences (100-50,200-100,200-50). Compute paired query correctness-set Jaccard, prediction disagreement and class count changes. Compute cross-seed prediction agreement and correctness Jaccard for each dataset/K. Do not treat repeated evaluation images as independent observations or run inferential tests.
cost: Single-thread numerical work; one-group pilot and checkpoint each group. Resume only checkpoints matching protocol, runner and input hashes. No paid compute and no new training.
outputs: Group NPZ with validation predictions/selection, original endpoint predictions, masks, query IDs and labels; CSV surfaces and sensitivity summaries, validation-best per-seed records, seed-paired stability and class counts, hashes, measured runtime and verification.
